descriptions.w3d_adjust_heap_803515ac: STLport __adjust_heap for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: sifts the hole down to a leaf, then pushes the value back up.
descriptions.w3d_make_heap_80351710: STLport make_heap for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: adjusts every parent from the middle down to the root.
descriptions.w3d_pop_heap_803517a4: STLport pop_heap for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: moves the top to the last slot and re-heaps the rest.
descriptions.w3d_partial_sort_80351804: STLport __partial_sort for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: heap-selects the leading elements into [first, middle) and sorts them.
descriptions.w3d_unguarded_partition_80351928: STLport __unguarded_partition for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: partitions around the pivot without bounds checks; returns the cut.
descriptions.w3d_introsort_loop_803519dc: STLport __introsort_loop for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: median-of-three quicksort down to 16-element runs, partial_sort when the depth limit runs out.
descriptions.w3d_unguarded_linear_insert_80351b34: STLport __unguarded_linear_insert for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: shifts elements up and drops the value into place.
descriptions.w3d_insertion_sort_80351b9c: STLport __insertion_sort for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: inserts each element, shifting the block up when it belongs first.
descriptions.w3d_unguarded_insertion_sort_80351c74: STLport __unguarded_insertion_sort_aux for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: unguarded linear insertion of every element in the range.
descriptions.w3d_final_insertion_sort_80351cdc: STLport __final_insertion_sort for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: insertion-sorts the first 16 elements, then the rest unguarded.
descriptions.w3d_sort_80351d58: STLport sort for {float key, int value} pairs in descending key order: introsort with depth limit 2*log2(n), then the final insertion sort.
